use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: Customer
The customer wants to monitor current and past auctions.

trigger.raw_text: The customer wants to monitor current and past auctions.

claims.content: The customer accesses the system to view their auction activity.
To monitor current auctions, the customer navigates to the search interface where they can filter by 'Current Auctions', product ID, or schedule date.
The system displays a list of current and scheduled auctions matching the search criteria, showing details such as description, current bid, and end time.
To monitor past auctions, the customer accesses the 'My Bid History' page.
The system presents the history sorted by ending time (most recent on top), divided into 'Items I've Won' and 'Items I Bid On, But Did Not Win'.
For won items, the customer views the payment status (e.g., 'Paid' or 'Not Paid') and can click links to proceed to payment if necessary.
The system displays a list of current and scheduled auctions matching search criteria, including description, current bid, and end time.
The system presents past auction history sorted by ending time (most recent on top), divided into 'Items I've Won' and 'Items I Bid On, But Did Not Win'.
For won items, the system displays payment status (e.g., 'Paid' or 'Not Paid') and provides links to proceed to payment if necessary.
The bid history includes the item's closing date/time, auction sequence numbers, product ID (SKU), customer's last bid, SmartBid (max bid), and the winning bid.
